thesis: The page is the scan tool's translator: every section pairs a machine reading in signal green with one plain sentence underneath, and the signature is the blinking cursor that types the code before the human answer resolves.

signature.name: Code-to-Plain Translator
signature.summary: Two-line primitive: monospaced code/measurement in signal green types in on scroll, then a sans-serif plain-English sentence fades up beneath. Cursor blinks once at end of code line. Hook: data-sw-signature='code-plain'.

palette.family: Scan Screen + Signal Green + Bay Steel

motion.intro: Code P0420 types in 0.7s, cursor blinks once, plain sentence fades up 0.3s after; total ≤1.0s; skippable via prefers-reduced-motion.
motion.hover: Buttons and cards lift 2px with 200ms ease-out; code lines show subtle green glow underline on hover.
